test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 04
subject: general
question:
Given below is a question followed by two statements. Analyze and decide whether the question can be answered from the given statements.

**Question:** Who is the sister of Esha?

**Statement I:** Esha is the daughter of the sister of Rina.

**Statement II:** Anna is the mother of two daughters, Esha and Tina.

options.text: Statement I and II together are not sufficient
Statement I and II together are sufficient

solution:
**Statement I:** Esha is the daughter of the sister of Rina.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50923a4e4e3c67ca240270e792526b77f717246b00818617baafcfb18c6d309a.png] 

We cannot say who is the sister of Esha using this statement.

**Statement II:** Anna is the mother of two daughters, Esha and Tina.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2e911258fae75c3c34bfb11ec63e0dcda0beff0434c54430ed5c37d0d7b5517.png] 

Esha and Tina are siblings, hence Tina is the sister of Esha.

Hence, “**Statement II alone is sufficient**” is the correct answer.
